nodes.description: External caller identity, attacker-controlled and used for every privilege check in SONGOKU (owner, allowance owner, whitelist, mint gating).
Privileged address; single point of access control for delegate, init, _mints, batchSend and setTradeAddress.
Public balance mapping, mutated without SafeMath in transferFrom and batchSend, and overwritten outright in _mints.
Nested allowance mapping, read/decremented in transferFrom and set to uint(-1) for the router in the constructor.
Whitelist mapping that bypasses the condition() sale restrictions in ensure().
Per-address sale counter incremented on every transferFrom and compared against _saleNum in condition().
Maximum number of sales per address, configured by init().
Minimum transfer amount enforced by condition().
Maximum transfer amount enforced by condition().
Privileged trading address that bypasses sale restrictions; set by owner via setTradeAddress.
Total token supply, scaled by decimals in the constructor.
Constant decimal scale (18) used in supply and sale-limit scaling.
Token name set in constructor.
Token symbol set in constructor.
Hardcoded Uniswap router constant used in the ensure() whitelist.
Public payable transfer that forwards msg.sender as the _from into transferFrom.
Core state-mutating function: decrements allowance, calls ensure(), then adjusts balances without SafeMath and increments _onSaleNum.
Whitelist/bypass gate comparing _from/_to against owner, UNI, tradeAddress and canSale, otherwise delegating to condition().
Sale policy checks on per-address sale count and min/max transfer amounts.
Public payable approval that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Owner-only function that performs an arbitrary low-level delegatecall to attacker-supplied address and calldata.
Mint function restricted by owner or a hardcoded address that overwrites balanceOf[spender] and whitelists the spender.
Owner-only configuration of _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
Owner-only loop distributing tokens, computing total = _value * _tos.length unchecked and emitting doubled Transfer events.
Owner-only setter for the privileged tradeAddress bypass.
Pure CREATE2-style pair address computation used by ensure() to detect the liquidity pair.
Initializes metadata, mints the entire supply to msg.sender and grants unlimited router allowance.
Raw delegatecall inside delegate(): executes untrusted bytecode in the SONGOKU storage context.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value in transferFrom with no SafeMath or pre-check on the arithmetic itself.
balanceOf[_to] += _value in transferFrom with no overflow protection.
total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend, multiplying user input without overflow checking.
_mints sets balanceOf[spender] = addedValue*10**decimals, overwriting balances without totalSupply accounting.

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared with _from to decide whether the allowance path is taken in transferFrom.

batchSend is gated by msg.sender == owner.
setTradeAddress is gated by msg.sender == owner.
delegate is gated by msg.sender == owner before performing a delegatecall.
Caller identity decides whether the arbitrary balance overwrite in _mints is reachable.
owner is derived from msg.sender and is the sole privilege reference for the contract.
transferFrom calls ensure() before any balance mutation.
